blocks.content: Saved queries lets you save a query for later and pull those queries back into the editor. This guide helps you both save and reintroduce saved queries while editing a dashboard panel. These can also be used in other features, like Explore!

Open a dashboard panel in **Edit**, use the **New query editor**, and select the query you want to save in **Queries & Expressions**. Saved queries require the feature and the appropriate account permissions.

blocks.prompt: Choose an unused name for the query you will save and reuse.
blocks.validationMessage: Use 1–64 letters, numbers, spaces, or hyphens; start with a letter.

blocks.content: Save your selected query with its name and description.
